item.title: A diabetes crisis: How glucose spikes can hit even thin, active millennials
item.description: Fat stored around internal organs—known as visceral fat—can exist even in people who look slim. This type of fat interferes directly with insulin action. Add to that chronic stress, poor sleep, and irregular eating, and the risk rises quietly.

item.title: Who is Mayur Patel? All about Kannada actor booked in Bengaluru drunk-driving case
item.description: Who is Mayur Patel? The Kannada actor and filmmaker, active since the early 2000s, is back in the spotlight after a Bengaluru drunk-driving case. From his film debut to Bigg Boss Kannada fame, here’s a closer look at his career, rise, and why he’s trending now.

item.title: How India-EU FTA could be a game changer for These 3 stocks
item.description: The India-EU Free Trade Agreement, sealed on Jan 27, 2026, promises a significant boost for Indian exporters. This pact eliminates high tariffs, creating zero-tariff access to the EU market. Textile and seafood sectors are poised for major gains. We analyze three key Indian stocks—Gokaldas Exports, KPR Mill, and Apex Frozen Foods—expected to thrive from increased margins and export growth under this landmark deal.

item.title: US declassifies Jumpseat Signals-collection satellite programme
item.description: The US National Reconaissance Office has declassified a signals-collection satellite programme that operated between 1971 and 2006. This was the first generation of satellites deployed in highly elliptical orbits (HEO) for the purpose of signal intelligence.

item.title: Snowfall aftermath in Uttarakhand: 77 villages affected in Chamoli; roads blocked, tourists stranded, administration on alert
item.description: Heavy snowfall and rain have disrupted life in Uttarakhand, affecting over 77 villages and blocking highways. Tourists are stranded, power supply has been hit, and slippery roads have made travel risky. Authorities have urged people to avoid unnecessary journeys as the cold intensifies.

item.title: Nvidia, Microsoft and Amazon in talks to pump $60 billion into OpenAI
item.description: OpenAI is reportedly in talks with Nvidia, Microsoft and Amazon for a massive funding round worth up to $60 billion. The money is expected to support the company’s growing need for computing power and AI infrastructure.

item.title: Google DeepMind launches AlphaGenome AI to identify genetic drivers of disease and speed up new treatments
item.description: Google DeepMind has launched AlphaGenome, a new AI tool that can analyse up to one million DNA letters at once to identify genetic drivers of disease. The system predicts how mutations affect gene regulation, helping researchers better understand cancer, heart disease, and inherited disorders.

item.title: Who is Saurabh Joshi – The new Chandigarh Mayor
item.description: Saurabh Joshi was on Thursday elected as the new mayor of Chandigarh. He is considered to be a very vocal leader, who has worked for civic issues in Chandigarh. He is recognised as a hard working councillor within the local BJP unit. His victory is not only significant for the BJP but also indicates that the party continues to dominate the municipal politics of Chandigarh.

item.title: Traditional surface war tactics moves to space
item.description: Stephen Whiting, Commander of the US Space Command has advocated for the adoption of traditional warfare principles in space. Whiting has called for large-scale preparatory exercises.
